prompt:
Create a single 16×16 pixel art warrior unit for a turn-based strategy game.
Only ONE character, centered.
No background, only transparent background.
Top-down / slightly isometric perspective.
Minimal Polytopia-style design: cute, blocky, simple shapes, strong silhouette, 3–5 colors.
The warrior holds a sword OR spear and a small shield.
No additional characters, no scenery, no environment.
Make it very readable at tiny size (16×16).
